experiment_receipt.scope: Archived experiment integrity and arithmetic; participant failures are measurements, not CI failures.

serialization_compatibility.compatibility_policy: Only operation=doc with three arguments: canonical positive decimal strings in original argv may remain identical strings or serialize as equal positive integers at indexes 1 and 2. All other arguments preserve both JSON type and value; booleans and floats are rejected.
serialization_compatibility.mechanism: The frozen Perl recorder stores a reference to argv in each event. Its doc range comparison and arithmetic set numeric flags on the existing scalar values; JSON::PP subsequently emits those line numbers as JSON integers. The archived request and event represent the same document and line-number values. Neither archive is rewritten.

No R6 comparative correctness, token cost, elapsed delivery time or documentation efficiency result is claimed by this CI run.
